title: 第40章 星纹追忆第39章 暗教余烬
lines: 天还没亮，学院地下四层就开了第一道封门。
黑曜石门往两侧退开，门缝里先漏出一线冷白星火。显曜走在最前，袖口束得很紧，手里那枚破损守护者徽章一直没松开。洛晖跟进来，肩甲上还留着昨夜暗紫灼痕。梅洛抱着卷匣，刚踩进门就低头看了一眼地上的古老契约阵。
“这地方真是写卷宗人的报应，连地板都比我资历老。”
没人接话。
第二道门开时，墙里传出一串锁扣回退声。第三道门后，古卷库终于露出来。
库内没有窗。十二块上古星图石板围着中央石台排开，黑曜石书架一层层压向后方，碎星晶嵌在架角，冷得发蓝。平时亮着微光的星纹，今天一块都没亮，像在等什么。
显曜走到石台前，把守护者徽章按进凹槽。
整间古卷库瞬间暗下去。
十二块石板上的微光像被一口吸进石缝，只剩凹槽边缘一丝细白冷光。显曜没立刻继续，先看向洛晖。
“这页史册，我亲手封了十年。”
洛晖站到石台另一侧，语气很平。
“十年够久了。再封下去，里头的字都该收门票了。”
显曜没笑。
“要开它，得两把钥。守护者徽章的活性星纹密钥，原初星纹的直接注火。洛沉进裂隙后，学院里再没有第二个原初星纹。”
洛晖没接话，右掌直接按上石面。
掌心星纹亮起。
他没开纹章，也没借王座，只放出最基础的一缕蓝火。蓝火顺着石纹钻进徽章，背面那道洛沉名字缩写一点点亮起来，像隔了十年，又被人重新刻了一遍。
下一刻，十二块石板同时亮了。
不是投影。
是石板自己醒了。
碎星晶在黑曜石表面缓慢移动，像有无形的手在重新排字。最上层是古老标记，中层坐标越来越密。到了最底端，最后一列第七个位置，石纹忽然停住，凝成一枚极熟悉的标记。
和洛晖掌心星纹几乎一模一样。
下面只烙着两个字。
洛沉。
洛晖的手还按在石台上，没动。
那枚标记边缘带着一圈暗紫灼痕，不是刻坏了，是里面烧穿了。裂开的蛛网纹一路往外爬，纹路很熟——和熔炉底座的共振符痕一样，和北山灰烬晶核里那条供能暗渠也一样。
显曜盯着那圈灼痕，指节慢慢压紧。
“这不是身份铭刻。”他说，“洛沉把自己的守护者标记封成了锚点，压在一条还在扩张的深海裂隙坐标上。”
话音刚落，底端那枚标记外侧的坐标阵列一层层亮起。
一道。
两道。
三道。
三组坐标被硬生生从守护者阵列里勾出来，分别落向三块石板。
左侧，深海遗宫祭坛。
中间，北山古矿脉裂隙网。
最下方，皇城广场正下。
三点一连，石板中央立起一个极规整的三角。
梅洛抱着卷匣往前凑了半步，脸上那点吊儿郎当收得干干净净。
“北山，广场，深海。长夏这是拿整座城当尺子量裂口。”
洛晖还没开口，胸前铜星坠忽然烫了一下。
银链一颤，坠子自己脱离，悬到石台上空。坠面那枚残缺星图被石板星纹一照，裂掉的半边轮廓一点点补齐。
另一半，不在铜坠上。
content_en:
Before dawn, the first sealed door was opened on the fourth underground floor of the college.
The obsidian door retreated to both sides, and a ray of cold white sparks first leaked out of the crack in the door. Xian Yao walked in the front, his cuffs tightly tied and the broken guardian badge in his hand never loosened. Luo Hui followed, with dark purple burn marks from last night still on his shoulder armor. Mero held the scroll box in his arms and looked down at the ancient contract formation on the ground as soon as he stepped through the door.
"This place is really the retribution of the person who wrote the file. Even the floor is senior to me."
No one answered.
When the second door opened, the sound of a series of locks retracting came from the wall. Behind the third door, the ancient scroll library was finally revealed.
There are no windows in the library. Twelve ancient star chart stone slabs are arranged around the central stone platform. Obsidian bookshelves are stacked layer by layer toward the back. Broken star crystals are embedded in the corners of the shelves, so cold they turn blue. The star pattern that usually shimmers brightly is not bright today, as if it is waiting for something.
Xian Yao walked to the stone platform and pressed the guardian badge into the groove.
The entire ancient scroll library went dark instantly.
The glimmer of light on the twelve stone slabs seemed to be sucked into the cracks of the stone, leaving only a thin white cold light on the edge of the groove. Xian Yao did not continue immediately and looked at Luo Hui first.
"I have personally sealed this page of history for ten years."
Luo Hui stood on the other side of the stone platform and spoke calmly.
"Ten years is long enough. If it is sealed any longer, the words inside will have to be charged for admission."
Xian Yao didn't smile.
"To open it, you need two keys. The active star pattern key of the guardian badge, and the direct fire injection of the original star pattern. After Luo Shen entered the rift, there was no second original star pattern in the academy."
Luo Hui didn't answer and pressed his right palm directly on the stone surface.
The star pattern on the palm lights up.
He didn't open a coat of arms or borrow a throne, he only released the most basic ray of blue fire. Blue fire penetrated the badge along the stone pattern, and the initials of Luo Chen's name on the back lit up little by little, as if it had been engraved all over again after ten years.
The next moment, twelve stone slabs lit up at the same time.
Not a projection.
It was Shi Ban who woke up on his own.
The broken star crystals move slowly on the obsidian surface, like invisible hands rearranging the words. The top layer is the ancient mark, and the coordinates in the middle layer are getting denser and denser. At the bottom, at the seventh position in the last row, the stone pattern suddenly stopped and condensed into a very familiar mark.
It is almost identical to the star pattern on Luo Hui's palm.
There are only two words branded underneath.
Luo Chen.
Luo Hui's hand was still pressed on the stone platform and did not move.
There was a circle of dark purple burn marks on the edge of the mark. It was either damaged or burned through inside. The cracked spider web pattern crawls all the way out, and the pattern is very familiar - the same as the resonance rune marks at the base of the furnace, and the same as the energy supply culvert in the ash crystal core of Beishan.
Xian Yao stared at the circle of burn marks and slowly pressed his knuckles together.
"This is not an identity engraving." He said, "Luo Chen sealed his guardian mark as an anchor point, pressing it on the coordinates of a deep sea rift that is still expanding."
As soon as he finished speaking, the coordinate array outside the mark at the bottom lit up layer by layer.
Together.
Two lanes.
Three ways.
Three sets of coordinates were forcibly drawn out of the guardian array and fell onto three stone slabs.
On the left, the Altar of the Deep Sea Palace.
In the middle, the fissure network of Beishan ancient mineral veins.
At the bottom, directly below the Imperial City Square.
Three points are connected together, and a very regular triangle stands in the center of the stone slab.
Mero took a half-step forward while holding the scroll box, all the carelessness on his face was gone.
"Beishan, the square, and the deep sea. Changxia is using the entire city as a ruler to measure the cracks."
Before Luo Hui could speak, the copper star pendant on his chest suddenly felt hot.
The silver chain trembled, and the pendant detached itself and hung above the stone platform. The incomplete star map on the fallen surface was illuminated by the star pattern on the stone slab, and the broken half of the outline was patched up bit by bit.
The other half is not on the copper pendant.
title_en: Chapter 40: Memories of Star Patterns Chapter 39: The Embers of the Dark Cult
